Binary-Quantized HNSW
nodes.rationale: Required because entities.embedding is vector(4096) and pgvector HNSW caps at 2000 dims — a plain vector index is impossible. Embeddings are converted to binary form for HNSW candidate lookup, then original vectors rerank.

nodes.label: Stage Failure-Rate Threshold
nodes.rationale: Extraction failures are recorded rather than silently dropped. Stage completes if failure rate stays at or below configured threshold; fails outright above it. This prevents silently missing entities or insights.

nodes.label: Stage Duration Baseline
nodes.rationale: Frozen, explicitly-snapshotted reference duration — NOT a moving average. A moving baseline rises with a gradual regression and would never register drift. Only updated when someone explicitly re-snapshots it.

nodes.label: Weekly Maintenance Sweep
nodes.rationale: Insight-merge scoped to recently-created insights by default — full-corpus sweep is opt-in, not routine. Merging duplicate entities, removing orphans, reconciling Postgres/Memgraph, refreshing stats. Dry-run by default; --execute applies changes and refuses while intake is active.

nodes.label: Community Run
nodes.rationale: Persisted in its own community_runs table — not the ingestion jobs table — because the jobs table is ingestion-shaped (source_id, ingestion stages). Every execution, sync or async, creates a run row with stable per-run community ids.

nodes.label: Virtual Entity Resolution
nodes.rationale: Run-local clustering of near-duplicate entities by embedding similarity. Merged entities collapse for that run only; nothing in stored entities or Memgraph is mutated. Stored data is never mutated by a community run.

nodes.label: Cross-Source Edge Cache
nodes.rationale: Persisted entity-pair similarity edges keyed on persistent entity ids, computed JIT and reused across runs. Derived data — safe to truncate. Invalidated by the weekly maintenance sweep when entities are merged.

nodes.label: Working Set
nodes.rationale: Scope resolution snapshots member ids at dispatch; later edits never change in-flight or completed runs. Global (no owner column) — single-user system, Principal ownership is deferred.
